name: listmonk
description: Production Zerops deployment recipes and API integration payloads for Listmonk

zerops_yaml_static_binary.description: Zerops production recipe using pre-compiled official Listmonk static binary on Alpine LXC
zerops_yaml_static_binary.yaml:
zerops:
  - setup: listmonk
    build:
      os: alpine
      prepareCommands:
        - sudo apk add --no-cache curl tar ca-certificates
        - curl -sSL https://github.com/knadh/listmonk/releases/download/v5.1.0/listmonk_5.1.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz -o listmonk.tar.gz
        - tar -xzf listmonk.tar.gz
        - chmod +x listmonk
      deployFiles:
        - listmonk
        - static
        - i18n
      cache:
        - listmonk.tar.gz
    run:
      os: alpine
      prepareCommands:
        - sudo apk add --no-cache ca-certificates tzdata curl
        - sudo mkdir -p /mnt/baiostorage/listmonk/uploads 2>/dev/null || true
        - sudo chmod -R 777 /mnt/baiostorage/listmonk/uploads 2>/dev/null || true
      initCommands:
        - zsc execOnce ${appVersionId} -- ./listmonk --install --idempotent --yes --config=""
        - zsc execOnce ${appVersionId} -- ./listmonk --upgrade --yes --config=""
      start: ./listmonk --config=""
      ports:
        - port: 9000
          httpSupport: true
      envVariables:
        LISTMONK_app__address: "0.0.0.0:9000"
        LISTMONK_db__host: ${db_hostname}
        LISTMONK_db__port: ${db_port}
        LISTMONK_db__user: ${db_user}
        LISTMONK_db__password: ${db_password}
        LISTMONK_db__database: ${db_database}
        LISTMONK_db__ssl_mode: disable

transactional_email_payload.description: Payload for sending high-throughput transactional emails via POST /api/tx

subscriber_creation_payload.description: Payload for creating or updating a subscriber in Listmonk
